Title: (LSJ) Games of Instinct + Slake the Thirst

Messages.Author: floppyzedolfin
Messages.Body:
Hi,

A enters combat with B via a successful Games of Instinct action.
"At the end of combat", B is not ready. A gains blood from Games of
instinct.

Can A play Slake the Thirst at inferior ?
Can A play Slake the Thirst at superior ?

Thanks

~~

Games of Instinct
Cardtype: Action
Requires a ready Sabbat vampire.
(D) Enter combat with an older vampire controlled by another
Methuselah. At the end of that combat, if only one combatant is ready,
that ready vampire gains blood equal to the opposing vampire's
capacity from the blood bank.

Slake the Thirst
Cardtype: Action Modifier / Combat
Discipline: Sanguinus
[san] [COMBAT] Only usable when this vampire gains blood. Choose
another ready Blood Brother of the same circle. That vampire gains the
same amount of blood from the bank.
[SAN] [ACTION MODIFIER] As above, but usable as an action modifier.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
On Mar 24, 9:46 am, floppyzedolfin <floppyzedol...@gmail.com> wrote:
> Hi,
>
> A enters combat with B via a successful Games of Instinct action.
> "At the end of combat", B is not ready. A gains blood from Games of
> instinct.
>
> Can A play Slake the Thirst at inferior ?
> Can A play Slake the Thirst at superior ?

A can play Slake the Thirst as an action modifier, but not as a combat
card.

Games of Instinct's blood gain has the same timing as Yawp Court,
which has the same timing as Save Face, which is after the combat
ends.

Well it has to be, else you'd not be able to play an action modifier,
and LSJ just ruled you can.

There needs to still be some action left in which to play action
modifiers after the combat has finished, else you'd not be able to play
Freak Drive, etc.

For instance, if a Blood Brother gains blood via hunting, can he play sup.

words, can you play StT with a vampire at full blood ?
